findings.issue: prepare(source,&RunConfig) and run(PreparedRun,&RunConfig) take config twice; nothing ties PreparedRun to its config.
findings.recommendation: run(prepared) consumes everything from PreparedRun (owns validated config snapshot or Arc); borrow only the registry.

findings.issue: BackendStatus::Failed{code: String, message: String} discards typed JevError; from_error_response is lossy and relabels message as recovery; code is free String over a closed set.
findings.recommendation: Failed(ScAgentErrorResponse) at minimum, or Result<JudgeOutcome,JevError> in memory with custom Serialize; restrict from_error_response to the producer-stderr case.

findings.issue: BackendAttestation{backend, input_sha256: Sha256Digest, ok: bool} has no honest value for a failed backend (non-optional digest + bool).
findings.recommendation: enum Attestation{Matched(d), Mismatched(d), Failed} or Option<Sha256Digest> with equal derived; private fields; specify dry-run value.

findings.issue: BackendCapabilities #[non_exhaustive] with pub fields returned by a required JudgeBackend method → downstream implementors cannot construct it; blanket non_exhaustive on Span/Subject/BackendDescriptor/BackendAttestation same problem; JudgeBackend open/sealed unstated; adding a required method is an open-trait break.
findings.recommendation: Constructor/builder for BackendCapabilities; triage non_exhaustive per type; state JudgeBackend intentionally open with future methods defaulted (ADR-SAG-0009/0027).

findings.issue: 'One sealing model' advertised as capability token is not sealed (pub doc(hidden) module); acceptance row 'as_str unreachable outside sc-agent-http' overstates.
findings.recommendation: State lint-enforced convention in ADR-SAG-0020 and fix the acceptance row, or move secret injection into a type that cannot leak (SecretHeader::apply(&mut dyn HeaderSink) only sc-agent-http's sink implements).

findings.issue: Rev half covered by a-10; repo-relative path half unresolved — InputSpec::Command adds a fourth raw String path; SubjectsBuilder::push_subject takes raw path.
findings.recommendation: RepoRelativePath newtype (TryFrom/FromStr/Deserialize) in r-1 schema work; use for InputSpec::{File,Command}.path, Subject.path, push_subject.

findings.issue: Reloads/tautology/double-prepare fixed; JudgeRequest still owns PayloadBundle cloned per backend; HttpRequest body ownership unspecified; ResolvedApiKey cloned per request; whether judge re-validates unstated.
findings.recommendation: HttpRequest{body: Arc<[u8]> or Cow}; ResolvedApiKey Arc<str>-backed; JudgeRequest holds Arc<PayloadBundle>; PreparedRun::request() returns shared handle; state judge does not re-validate.

findings.issue: Only non_exhaustive added; PayloadBundle fields still pub in-crate (a-10 made them private — plan should reflect); LogEvent.operation String, Question.id/question_id Strings, blob_sha/schema/mode raw, bool pair; new pub-field contract types added.
findings.recommendation: Explicit r-1 deliverable: Operation enum, QuestionId and BlobSha newtypes, struct instead of bool pair; accessors on invariant-bearing types.

findings.issue: dyn-vs-generic undecided at new seams: Arc<dyn Fn() -> SystemTime> clock on a stateless store; Transport/RetrySleeper dispatch model unstated.
findings.recommendation: Backend<T: Transport = UreqTransport>; fn pointer or generic clock; fold sleeper into BusyPolicy or mark test-only; note object safety.

findings.issue: non_exhaustive enum does not stop downstream literals (wrong hint can recur); recovery: String field AND exhaustive fix_hint() = two sources; RegistryInvalid/SessionDocumentInvalid carry no detail; source()==None blanket-stated.
findings.recommendation: Variant-level non_exhaustive or constructor-only docs; one source of recovery text; add detail to bare variants; ADR-SAG-0027 states source() rule per variant class.

findings.issue: Infallible constructors need every input pre-validated: endpoint/https-only untyped; CheckSource::CallerRequest(Value) defers parsing; RunConfig::new Vec<BackendId> no empty/duplicate rule.
findings.recommendation: https-validated Endpoint newtype; typed CallerRequest in CheckSource; validate backends non-empty/unique.

findings.issue: SubjectsDocument deserializable pub-field struct validated by separate validate() — unvalidated docs can reach the engine; RunResponse has two serialization paths (derive + to_envelope_data Value).
findings.recommendation: serde(try_from) or ValidatedSubjects wrapper; typed EnvelopeData or pick one serialization.

findings.issue: serde alias 'so Phase A session files still load' insufficient: probabilities removed and input_sha256 required → old session files fail to load or misbehave.
findings.recommendation: Bump session document version mapping old files to SessionDocumentInvalid with 're-run' recovery, or Option on read; test loads a Phase A fixture.

findings.issue: Backend facts in 3-4 places (BACKENDS rows, serde renames, capabilities.family duplicating descriptor.family, id()); 'open' is additive-closed; mixed u64/usize byte units; grep-test enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Derive capabilities().family from descriptor; roundtrip test covering serde/Display/FromStr; ADR-SAG-0009 says open = additive; one byte-count type.

notes: No removed pattern reintroduced; SessionStore/Extractor/RwLock/string-prefix hints deleted not shimmed
Equal-input digest design sound (trusts backend; ADR-SAG-0025 should say so)
Naming drift: plan.md JevError::Network vs r-1 NetworkError
dry-run equal value unspecified in r-2b
